subject: Vendor tax packet + EU VAT evidence needed to release invoice
messages:
From: Evelyn Brooks <finance@lumen-tech.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-20T08:14:00-04:00
Subject: Invoice PO#789 + tax docs required to schedule payment

Hi Lauren,

We received the PO and invoice for August (PO#789, attached). Our AP team is ready to process, but compliance flagged that we need either a W-9 (if Redwood is treated as a US payee) or a completed W-8BEN-E (for our EU entity to claim treaty/foreign status) plus an EU VAT reverse-charge certificate to support VAT-exempt handling.

Can you confirm which tax form we should expect from Redwood and whether the payment will be issued from Redwood Inc (US) or Redwood EU (Luxembourg)? Also include ACH instructions and the tax identifier your team prefers on the remittance.

Attachments: PO_789_invoice.pdf (PDF, 142KB)

Thanks,
Evelyn Brooks
Finance Manager | Lumen Tech GmbH
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Evelyn Brooks <finance@lumen-tech.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-20T10:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Invoice PO#789 + tax docs required to schedule payment

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the PO. Quick answers up front:
- Redwood will be paid from Redwood Inc (US entity) for this contract, so a W-9 is what you should expect from us for 1099 reporting, unless Lumen requires payment to Redwood EU, in which case we'd provide a W-8BEN-E.
- To avoid confusion, can you confirm whether Lumen will reverse-charge VAT or if you need a VAT registration from Redwood EU? If you plan reverse-charge, we can provide the certificate for your AP record.

Ben — looping you in since you handle vendor onboarding. Karthik — can payments ops confirm ACH fields we should provide and whether Redwood needs to be set as a US payee for your system or as a foreign vendor?

I’m attaching our standard vendor packet and the vendor portal link where you can upload payment forms. If you prefer, we can sign the W-9 and return via DocuSign.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet_v3.pdf (doc), vendor_portal_submission_receipt.html (stub link)

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Mathias Dubois <mathias.d@lumen-tech.eu>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-21T09:46:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Invoice PO#789 + tax docs required to schedule payment

Hi Lauren — thanks for clarifying. We actually prefer to pay the EU legal entity for this engagement so that local VAT handling is straightforward. Attached is our vendor onboarding form and the fields our AP system requires.

We also attached a draft W-8BEN-E that our tax counsel pre-populated (marked as "for review") — the goal is to ensure Redwood EU has the correct chapter 3 status recorded in our system to avoid 30% withholding. Please confirm whether Redwood EU will sign the W-8BEN-E and provide a Luxembourg VAT registration extract (or a reverse-charge certificate).

Quote of your earlier message:
> Redwood will be paid from Redwood Inc (US entity) for this contract, so a W-9 is what you should expect from us for 1099 reporting...

If payment is from Redwood EU, we will not issue a 1099. If payment is from the US entity, we will require the W-9 and will include the payee TIN on the remittance.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_lumen.docx, W-8BEN-E_draft_for_review.pdf, VAT_reverse_charge_certificate.pdf

Best,
Mathias Dubois
Senior AP Analyst | Lumen Tech GmbH
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Mathias Dubois <mathias.d@lumen-tech.eu>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-22T13:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice PO#789 + tax docs required to schedule payment

Mathias — thanks for the detail. A couple of operational notes from Payments/Ops team:
1) If you intend to pay Redwood EU, please confirm the exact payee legal name (Redwood Inference SARL or Redwood Inference Luxembourg S.à r.l. — we will provide the signed W-8BEN-E and Luxembourg VAT certificate in that case).
2) If payment will come from Redwood Inc (US), we will provide a completed and signed W-9 (EIN: 12-3456789) and full ACH instructions. In the absence of a completed W-9/W-8, your system may apply backup withholding; we cannot have funds held for 1099 uncertainty.
3) ACH instructions (if paying US entity):
   - Bank: Pacific Gate Bank
   - Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - ABA: 026009593
   - Account: 004123456789
   - Remittance email: ap@redwood.com

Grace — can you prepare a brief remittance note and confirm whether we can supply a DocuSign link for the signed tax forms?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Payments & Treasury
Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Mathias Dubois <mathias.d@lumen-tech.eu>, Evelyn Brooks <finance@lumen-tech.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-24T11:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Invoice PO#789 + tax docs required to schedule payment

Mathias / Evelyn — quick update: we confirmed internally that Lumen will be set up as a payee under Redwood Inference Luxembourg S.à r.l. Payment ops will accept payment from your EU entity. Attached are the signed W-8BEN-E (for Redwood EU), the Luxembourg VAT extract, and a remittance stub showing payment scheduled for 2026-09-24.

We also uploaded the vendor onboarding form to your portal and sent the signed PDF via DocuSign (link below). Unless you flag any issues, AP should see the wire/SEPA credit hit by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: W-8BEN-E_signed.pdf, VAT_reverse_charge_certificate.pdf, remittance_20260924.pdf
Links: https://app.docusign.com/rel/abc123

Thanks for the quick coordination — let me know if you need the W-9 instead; otherwise we'll keep records under the Luxembourg entity.

Best,
